vigtext: You see a coach celebrating with the opposing team's players who just won the game.
You see a woman spanking her child with a spatula for getting bad grades in school.
You see a woman continuing to wear a large sun hat inside her apartment complex.
You see a customer walking out the coffee shop with the store’s mug cup.
You see a man searching through the trash to find women's discarded underwear.
You see a story about a remote tribe eating the flesh of their deceased members.
You see a soldier disobeying a lawful order from their commanding officer.
You see a mother taking money from her child’s college fund to pay for her own expenses.
You see a former US General saying publicly he would never buy any American product.
You see a mother favoring one child over the other, constantly neglecting the other child's needs.
You see a player publicly yelling at his soccer coach during a playoff game.
You see a boy telling a woman that she looks just like her overweight bulldog.
You see a woman drinking her entire cup of coffee using a stirring spoon.
You see a roommate not cleaning the shared living space according to the agreed schedule.
You see cars passing by when an old man is stuck on the crossroad.
You see an employee taking a monitor from the company and using it for personal use at his home.
You see a teenage girl wearing a long trench coat on a hot summer afternoon.
You see a teacher hitting a student's hand with a ruler for falling asleep in class.
You see people running away from a fire instead of putting it out.
You see a staff member talking loudly and interrupting the mayor's speech to the public.
You see people humiliating a neighbor to force them to move out.
You see someone cheating in a card game while playing with a group of strangers.
You see a judge taking on a criminal case although he is friends with the defendant.
You see a coworker promising to cover a shift for another coworker, but does not show up at the last minute.
